title: Surrounded Regions
keyIdea: An O survives only if it connects to the border. DFS from every border O and mark what it reaches; then every unmarked O is surrounded and becomes X.

approaches.name: DFS from the border
approaches.idea: DFS from each O on the first/last row and column, marking vis; flip every O not in vis.
approaches.why: Each cell is visited at most once.

quiz.q: Why start the search from the border instead of from each O?
options: One pass from the border marks exactly the O's that are not surrounded
The ones not reachable from any border O
